Parts in [square brackets] are left out when a placeholder in them is empty, e.g. {'{'}title{'}'}[ ({'{'}year{'}'})].

form.name: Name
form.adminPinHint: Admins need a PIN once there is more than one profile. 4 to 8 digits.

channels.noEditor: Viewing works, editing doesn't: DreamHub needs the "BouquetEditor" plugin on the box for that. It isn't installed there or doesn't answer.

find.more: … and {n} more — narrow the search or filters

check.allGood: All fine: no duplicate or vanished channels, all with programme data and a logo.

gone.title: No longer on the box
gone.explain: These entries are still in the bouquet, but the box doesn't know the channel anymore — usually after a channel scan. On the TV they show a black picture.

duplicate.title: Twice in a bouquet
duplicate.explain: The same channel is in the same bouquet twice.

noEpg.title: No programme right now
noEpg.explain: The box has no programme data for these channels at the moment. That can be normal (off air, data channels) or point to an outdated entry.

noPicon.title: Without a logo
noPicon.explain: DreamHub finds no picture for these channels in any logo set.

picons.explain: The logo sets installed on the box, and how many channels of your bouquets each covers. DreamHub shows logos from the chosen set first — nothing changes on the TV.
picons.none: No logo sets were found on the box.
picons.autoHint: The most recently changed set first, then the others.
picons.saved: Saved. New logos show after the page is loaded again.

edit.name: Name
edit.backupNote: The whole channel list is backed up first. If anything doesn't go as shown, DreamHub restores the backup by itself.
edit.saved: Saved. The channel list was backed up first (below, under "Backups").

bouquet.name: Name of the bouquet
bouquet.deleteAsk: Delete the bouquet "{name}" with all its entries? The channels themselves stay on the box.

backups.title: Backups
backups.explain: Before every change DreamHub backs up the whole channel list. You can bring an earlier state back here.
backups.restoreAsk: Set the channel list back to how it was on {date}? Everything changed since is lost.
backups.restored: Restored. The state before was backed up first.

channels.restore: The channel list comes back from the backup
